question: Can spiritual efficacy exist without an assisting cause, and who counts as a brother in this sense?
premises: A yogi may have capacity even without an assisting cause.
Those born of one cause are brothers.
Anyone similar in that respect may also be counted as such.
inference: While an assisting cause is ordinarily needed, a yogi may transcend that need, and spiritual brotherhood extends to those sharing the same causal basis.
plain_english: Just as a yogi may have capacity even without an assisting cause, those born of one cause are brothers; and anyone similar to that may also be regarded in the same way.
